questions.question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Slacken
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. Decrease.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"slacken"** means to make or become less active, vigorous, or intense; to loosen or relax. (ढीला करना)

 
 
• **Example: **During the holidays, many employees tend to slacken their work pace.
 
 
 
• **"Decrease" **refers to making something smaller or less in size, amount, intensity, or degree. (घटाना)
 
 
• **Example: **The company decided to decrease its production due to low demand.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that "slacken" is synonymous with "decrease".

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. Decrease.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Irritate** (चिढ़ाना): To make someone annoyed or a little angry.

 
 
• **Example:** Loud noises can irritate people who are trying to concentrate.
 
 
 
• **Tighten** (कसना): To make or become tight or tighter.
 
 
• **Example: **Make sure to tighten the screws to secure the shelf properly.
 
 
 
• **Increase** (बढ़ाना): To make or become greater in size, amount, or degree.
 
 
• **Example:** The company plans to increase its workforce by 20% next year.

questions.question:
**Directions:** Given below are some idioms/phrases followed by four alternative meanings to each. Choose the response (a), (b), (c) or (d), which is the most appropriate meaning and mark your response on the Answer Sheet accordingly.

Look to your laurels

options.text: To make an extra effort to secure one's position
To look suitable for a particular situation

questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**To make an extra effort to secure one's position**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom "**Look to your laurels**" means to be careful to maintain one's success, reputation, or position because others may challenge it.
 
• It suggests staying alert and making continued efforts to protect what one has achieved.
 
• Therefore, the meaning "**To make an extra effort to secure one's position**" is the most appropriate.
 
• **Options 2, 3, and 4** do not convey the actual meaning of the idiom.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

**Example Sentence:** *"The champion must look to his laurels as many new players are competing strongly."*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** refers to appearance or suitability, which is unrelated to the idiom.
 
• **Option 3:** means physically guarding trophies, which is a literal and incorrect interpretation.
 
• **Option 4:** means self-praise, which is not the meaning of the idiom.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM for the highlighted word.

The cricketer is in **sublime** form.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"sublime"** means something of such excellence, grandeur, or beauty as to inspire great admiration or awe. (उत्कृष्ट)

 
 
• **Example: **The musician's performance was **sublime**, leaving the audience in awe.
 
 
 
• **"Inferior"** refers to something lower in rank, status, or quality. (निम्न)
 
 
• **Example: **The quality of this product is** inferior **compared to the other brands available in the market.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'sublime' **is **'inferior'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Interior** (आंतरिक): Relating to the inside of something.

 
 
• **Example:** The interior design of the house is very modern and stylish.
 
 
 
• **Superior** (श्रेष्ठ): Higher in rank, status, or quality.
 
 
• **Example: **The new model of the car is superior in performance compared to the older one.
 
 
 
• **Exterior** (बाहरी): Relating to the outside of something.
 
 
• **Example:** The exterior of the building was recently renovated.

questions.question:
Complete the following idiomatic expression with the correct option:

Well, that's fine kettle of _____ I thought I was helping John but he worked against me during the debate session.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**fish**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiomatic expression "**fine kettle of fish**" refers to a tricky or awkward situation. (मुश्किल या असहज स्थिति)
 
• In the sentence, the speaker is highlighting an unexpected and problematic situation.
 
• The other options: "**soup**," "**tea**," and "**broth**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Well, that's a fine kettle of fish__; I thought I was helping John but he worked against me during the debate session.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Soup (सूप)**: a liquid dish typically made by boiling meat, fish, or vegetables.
 
• **Tea (चाय)**: a hot drink made by infusing the dried crushed leaves of the tea plant in boiling water.
 
• **Broth (शोरबा)**: a thin soup made by boiling meat, fish, or vegetables in water.

questions.question:
Give a single word that substitutes for the following expression.

A collection of historical documents or records
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 (Archives)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Archives"** refers to a collection of historical documents or records providing information about a place, institution, or group of people. (पुरालेख / अभिलेखागार)

 
 
• **Example:** The university's archives hold many rare manuscripts and letters from the 18th century.
 
 
 
• **"Library"** refers to a building or room containing collections of books, periodicals, and sometimes films and recorded music for people to read, borrow, or refer to. (पुस्तकालय)
 
 
• **Example:** I borrowed this book from the local library last week.
 
 
 
• While a library holds books and resources for public use, archives specifically hold historical records and documents that are preserved for research or reference.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 (Archives)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Library** (पुस्तकालय): A place where books, media, and other resources are stored for public use.

 
 
• **Example:** Students often spend hours studying in the library before exams.
 
 
 
• **Cache** (गुप्त भंडार): A hidden storage space, especially for valuables or data.
 
 
• **Example:** The hikers discovered a cache of supplies hidden in the cave.
 
 
 
• **Granary** (अनाज का भंडार): A storage place for grain, especially in farming.
 
 
• **Example:** The farmer filled the granary with freshly harvested wheat.

**Direction: **Item in this section consists of a sentence with an underlined word followed by four words/groups of words. Select the option that is nearest in meaning to the underlined word and mark your response on the Answer Sheet accordingly.

She has a genetic __predisposition__ to liver disease.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**vulnerability**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **predisposition**: a condition that makes somebody/something likely to behave in a particular way or suffer from a medical condition.
 
• **vulnerability**: the quality or state of being exposed to the possibility of being attacked or harmed, either physically or emotionally.
 
• Hence, the option that is nearest in meaning to the underlined word is 'vulnerability'.
